summary.text: EUCRISA was reviewed as a standard NDA (application received 01/07/2016, PDUFA goal date 01/06/2017); the applicant's priority review request was denied and no advisory committee was convened. Approval was based on two adequate and well-controlled Phase 3 vehicle-controlled trials (AN2728-AD-301 and AN2728-AD-302), with a deferred pediatric study required under PREA as a postmarketing requirement.
